chunks: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, was asked about a man kissing his wife while he is fasting. He said:
"Is she anything but a fragrant flower that he smells?"
And better than that is for the fasting person to refrain from kissing.

key_terms.رَيْحَانَةٌ: a fragrant flower or sweet-smelling plant, used here as a comparison
key_terms.صَائِمٌ: a person in the state of fasting

ai.seo_question: Does kissing one's wife invalidate the fast in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates that kissing one's wife during fasting is not itself treated as invalidating the fast. At the same time, it states that the more preferable conduct is for the fasting person to avoid kissing, reflecting caution and etiquette during worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1874 - The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was asked about a man kissing his wife while he is fasting.
He (sw) said: "Is she anything but a fragrant flower to smell?"
